basic_info.description: Last unit available! Newly remodeled view home in a premium Glen Park location! Situated on a serene, tree-lined street, this 2 bedroom and 1.5 bath flat enjoys amazing southerly views. The living/kitchen area has been re-designed in a modern, open concept style, allowing lovely southern light to flood the home. All new LG stainless steel appliances in a large eat-in kitchen with plentiful cabinetry, lovely quartz countertops, and pretty tile backsplash. Charming period features, including bay windows and wainscoting, blend with new wide plank oak floors, designer tile, and elegant plumbing fixtures. A new LG washer and dryer are located on a laundry porch off the kitchen, which leads to a south-facing rear terrace and fenced yard. A large storage room is included! Stroll to the heart of Glen Park Village and the BART station or take advantage of easy access to 280 and 101 freeways for longer commutes. Photos are of a similar unit.
